title: mcp-remote
summary: A proxy that lets a local MCP client talk to a remote MCP server. The tools an agent gets through it are the remote server's, so its capabilities cannot be assigned from this package's identity at all; they belong to whatever it connects to. Recorded with no claims on purpose. The command execution in AVE-2026-0014 is a flaw in some versions, not a capability, and lives in that advisory.

unknown.note: Depends entirely on the remote server being proxied.
